remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(odbccp32.dll odbccp32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# odbccp32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/odbccp32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(odbccp32_shims OBJECT odbccp32.c)
target_link_libraries(odbccp32_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(odbccp32_shims)
add_cargo_module(odbccp32 odbccp32-cargo odbccp32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS odbccp32_shims psdk uuid_sources)
